title: helanthium parvulum
intro: Helanthium parvulum, commonly known as American water-celery or wild celery, is a perennial aquatic plant native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, acting as a natural diuretic, and possessing antioxidant properties that may help protect against certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Helanthium parvulum include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
